title: Time to Form a Habit: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Health Behaviour Habit Formation and Its Determinants.
quote: Emerging evidence on health-related habit formation indicates that while habits can start forming within about two months, the time required varies significantly across individuals
summary: Revisão sistemática com metanálise (20 estudos, 2.601 participantes): hábitos de saúde começam a se formar em cerca de dois meses, com tempo muito variável entre pessoas; medianas relatadas de 59 a 66 dias.
